description.value: Mediterranean Market is a specialty food shop in Vernon focusing on Italian, Mediterranean, and European products, with a well-stocked deli counter featuring cured meats and cheeses. The store is known for award-winning sub sandwiches made to order, making it a practical stop for a hot or fresh meal. A second Kelowna location also exists, and the business runs a seasonal home wine-making grape and juice program.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is a two-location specialty Mediterranean/European food market with a deli operation in Vernon. OSM had no phone number; the website supplies the Vernon location phone (250) 260-1331 and a full postal address. Neither OSM tags nor website content mention bike parking, water, washrooms, or any cycling-specific amenities, so those fields default to null.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: An operating specialty deli and food market on a Vernon arterial road; a touring cyclist could resupply with quality food and made-to-order sandwiches, making it a worthwhile directory listing.
enrichment_extras.notes: Business has two locations (Vernon and Kelowna); this record corresponds to the Vernon location at 3115 48 Ave. Email for both locations is inquiries@mediterraneanmarket.ca.
